title: The exposed transfer

branches.condition: Shared passage is delivered without protection
branches.consequence: Lantern's navigation team is lost. Grey Petrel on Tender cover can save the team, using its contracted service.

branches.condition: Shared passage is delivered with Guard or an effective Warrant
branches.consequence: The navigation team survives this threat. Tender cover is not called upon.
This threat does not take the navigation team. A failed or halted operation can still have other consequences.

guidance: You can seek protection, change the voyage or arrange Tender cover while the relevant decisions remain open. Protection does not mend the route.
